Name: talkohlooeys' Seasonal Rasmodia Portraits
Author: alextofu
Description:
[size=3]Small mod that adds seasonal variants to the Rasmodia Extended Portrait in talkohlooeys' style.

Huge thank you to both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/78766618]talkohlooeys [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/113211223]kragonaught [/url]for their work! I have gotten their permission to post this (despite both having open perms I just wanted to check in with them lol)[/size]


[b][color=#8e7cc3][size=5]Instructions:[/size]

[size=4]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265]Romanceable Rasmodia[/url] although technically it isn't a requirement, portraits just wouldn't work as intended.[/size]


[/color][/b][b][size=5]CP Version:[/size][/b]
[size=4]1. Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10971]HD Portraits[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/size]
[size=4]2. Download and unzip into your mods folder.[/size]



[b][size=5]Replacer Version:[/size][/b]
[size=4]1. Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11904]1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits[/url].[/size]
[size=4]2. Download and unzip this mod.[/size]
[size=4]3. Find the Wizard folder inside of 1onexs and talkohlooey's Seasonal Portraits and overwrite the images.
[/size]

[size=6][b][color=#cc0000]Important !!![/color][/b]
[/size][size=4]If you use the replacer version[/size][u],[/u][size=4] you need to drag and drop the files into the already existing mod. It [/size][b][u][size=4]doesn't [/size][/u][/b][size=4]do anything on it's own, download the CP version for that.[/size]

[size=4]It should work with SVE as long as you have also configured all other prerequisite mods and if needed replace the files in the SVE variant of the portraits as well.[/size]

[size=3]
There used to be a Seasonal Rasmodia mod that added sprites which you can also see in my screenshot but it is sadly no longer available for unknown reasons, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12283]this mod[/url] might do the job just fine though.

Once again stating that assets aren't mine to use, I just made seasonal variants of already existing work so please go download and support the originals and ask them for any permission about editing any of it! And please let me know if there are any issues.[/size]
